plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Safety and review of Claude's output, styled after claude-flightdeck (rounded role-coloured boxes, ▰▱ gauges, busy rails; every button also has a hotkey; options palette theme|pastel and motion). Six mods, each toggled in the plugin config. blast-radius: holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE...) behind a BLAST RADIUS card showing the files at risk (three rows on the terminal, a full box on the desktop); pick Proceed or Cancel. secret-sentry: denies Write/Edit/NotebookEdit that would put API keys, tokens or private keys in a file (.env and *.example exempt). reflect: spots lasting corrections in your prompts (or 'remember: ...') and offers to save them to ./CLAUDE.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; /reflect-queue, /reflect-pause. assumption-tracker: after each turn lists what Claude assumed; mark Right or Wrong (or 1-8 to cycle) and send a fix for the wrong ones (f); /assumptions. self-critique: /critique [auto|opus|sonnet|haiku] reviews Claude's last answer with a verdict, flaws and a Make this fix button (r rerun, a auto, m model, 1-n fix). prompt-coach: on the first prompt of a session only (a first /command or skill prompt included; tracked per session id so a reload cannot re-fire it) it holds the prompt and shows one improved prompt in a side pane, with instructions telling the main session to grill you about ambiguities and unclear requirements before it starts; Use in prompt box (u, to edit before sending), Copy (c), Request changes (e) or Dismiss (d, sends the original); a first /command keeps its line verbatim at the top; a first prompt with attachments is sent as typed and the improved text is only offered; never auto-triggers again after the first prompt; /sharpen [prompt] runs it any time (typed text, else the prompt box, else your last message).

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Live session dashboard in one side pane, styled after claude-flightdeck: rounded role-coloured panels, ▰▱ gauges, animated connectors and live clocks. /cockpit [close|reset|layout auto|compact|wide|mini] opens it (docked beside the transcript in fullscreen, an 8-row summary inline otherwise, opens on start at 144+ columns); focus with ctrl+x tab for hotkeys. With the pane closed, calm mods share one summary line above the prompt with an Open button; a mod draws its own band only when it needs attention. Options: palette (theme|pastel), motion, layout, openOnStart, paneColumns, maxCards, architectPattern, matchDescriptions, moments, architectLabel, gateLabel. Twelve mods, each toggled in the plugin config. agents-progress: agents as cards or swimlanes with tokens, steps and clocks (1-6 expand, a finished), task progress; /agents-info opens the pane. cache-keeper: cache row with countdown, a band in the last 5 minutes or when cold, cold-send dialog (continue here or new session) with cost estimate; /keepwarm [90m|2h|off|status] pings to hold the cache (k), /cache-tax shows its state. context-health: context gauge with compactions, turn, speed and cost, a warning band with Handoff and Fresh; /ctx-handoff writes .claude/handoff.md and continues in a clean context, /autohandoff [percent|off] does it automatically. usage-limits: session (5h) and weekly (7d) limit gauges with reset countdown and pace, a band from 70% and a toast at 90%. filetree: /filetree opens a file tree with git status and highlights for files Claude reads, edits and commits. next-steps: three suggested next prompts after each turn; click one to fill the prompt. token-meter: tokens and cost this session; details (t) shows input, output and cache tokens, the project's total across past sessions of this folder (rescan), cost per turn and tokens per model. architect: consults with advisor-type agents or server tools on a timeline, their inferred moment and the advice. permission-gate: one cell per permission check (allowed, cleared, pending, denied) with file/shell/other drill-downs (f/s/o), credentials masked; observe only. loops: model loops no agent claims (workflow agents, compactions, forks). turn-receipt: the running turn's clock, or the last turn's duration, agents, edits, errors and cost. session-log: prompts, spawns, completions, consults, edits, errors and denials, filtered to the agent in view.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: General-purpose skills, triggered by plain requests or named directly. commit-changes ('commit this'): commits the session's changes as atomic Conventional Commits with a why-first body, splits unrelated work, adds ticket refs (#123, PROJ-123), leaves other dirty files alone, never pushes. create-pr ('open a PR'): pushes the branch and opens or updates a PR filled from the repo's template (or a built-in one) with why, what, verification and review focus; drops commits already merged by squash. github-repo-setup ('set up this repo properly'): via gh, creates or hardens a repo with a branch-protection ruleset, squash-only merges, CI, CodeQL, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, PR template, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, secret scanning and optional signed commits.
